descriptions.w3d_chute_logic_step_800da388: Resolves the chute owner, invalidates missing owners and selects open or close handling.
descriptions.w3d_chute_logic_value_800da4a8: Returns a resolved chute owner value or the shared default when the owner is absent.
descriptions.w3d_chute_close_800da750: Posts a pending chute value as an integer message and clears the pending field.
